amendment_reason: v1's regime is first-order Markov with geometric dwell, so the exact posterior is a sufficient statistic and v1 says so itself. Under that physics a network can only tie the belief planner -- the measured failure mode of Q, V, G2 and G3 -- which leaves v1 able to produce an amortization claim and structurally unable to produce a quality premium. A minimum dwell makes the truth semi-Markov and the first-order filter misspecified, which is the only condition under which a learner has ever beaten a belief-MPC in this project (contention_v1: +0.0136, LCB95 +0.0124). Amended before any seed exists, as v1's own versioning rule requires.

amortization: A1: G0-G5 pass; H_ret is not required
A2: high-budget planner breaches the frozen absolute SLA or binding lifecycle break-even at N=4 and N=8
A3: noninferiority margin, power, hardware, warm-up, caching and latency protocol are frozen
quality_residual_rl: Q0: G4b passes and the d_min=1 control shows no learner advantage
Q1: same-information observable headroom over the high-budget best structured controller exceeds the frozen quality SESOI
Q2: bounded residual action, reward, simple residual baselines and total compute accounting are frozen
Q3: authorizes residual RL only; failure does not block the amortization branch
recurrent_representation: R1: model-independent conditional-history value beyond current sufficient snapshot plus explicit belief
R2: retained beats reset, delayed and shuffled out of sample while the exact-belief sufficient-statistic null does not spuriously pass
R3: authorizes one small GRU primary candidate; LSTM remains sensitivity only

claim_tiers.T0_feedback_value: Simultaneous LCB95(H_obs)>0 under the frozen multiplicity family. This may be satisfied by a classical policy and is not a neural premium.
claim_tiers.T1_neural_quality: Statistical superiority requires simultaneous LCB95(Delta_N_quality)>0; material quality additionally requires LCB95 at or above the prospectively frozen quality SESOI. Imitation alone is ineligible for this tier. ReT and Cobb-Douglas remain frozen secondary reports. Under this amendment T1 additionally requires the d_min=1 control to show NO learner advantage and the exact semi-Markov disclosure arm to be reported alongside every T1 number.
claim_tiers.T2_neural_amortization: Only after the amortization branch proves the high-budget planner breaches an absolute operational SLA or a binding repeated-query break-even: simultaneous LCB95(Delta_N_quality) must be at least minus the frozen noninferiority margin, neural p95 must satisfy the SLA and be at least 10x lower on fixed hardware at both N=4 and N=8. DES-call reduction is reported but cannot replace either latency condition.
claim_tiers.T3_neural_generalization: Quality and amortization generalization are adjudicated separately on explicitly frozen OOD families without neural retraining; no generic unseen-topology claim is allowed in this version.
claim_tiers.deployment_safety: Worst-product and tail guardrails are a separate deployability adjudication. Failure qualifies or blocks deployment but does not erase a correctly estimated feedback effect.
claim_tiers.offline_cost_disclosure: Training, expert-data generation, planner compilation and belief-update costs are reported and included in break-even analysis.

comparator_ladder: all constants and all 4^8 open-loop calendars at the executable N=2 anchor
bounded or exact open-loop search at N=4 and N=8, with optimization uncertainty propagated into H_obs
exact semi-Markov filter over (regime, time-since-switch) -- DISCLOSURE ARM, reported always and never the bar the learner must clear
budget-matched structured planner under the operational SLA

demand_and_information.action_liveness_scope: Every action must be live in the primary nonfungible cells. Action collapse is required, not a failure, in the fungible null.
causal_event_order: clone the predecision physical state and RNG state for all paired arms
at t=0 draw Z_0 from the prior; otherwise enter with the previously transitioned Z_t
construct a strictly half-open observation with no same-time demand outcome
choose and lock the three-batch allocation
realize current demand and physical events
update the posterior from realized demand and transition to Z_{t+1} for the next decision
demand_and_information.confounding_rule: Secondary OOD factors remain off in the primary mechanism test and enter only after the relevant branch-specific gates close. Unseen topology is not an OOD claim until a real graph/BOM extension is separately frozen.
demand_and_information.h4_identification: At every cycle boundary, retained and reset/delayed/shuffled arms start from byte-identical physical inventory, backlog, age ledger, pipeline and RNG state. Only the knowledge state is intervened on.

iid_regime_null.expected_result: Retained regime history cannot beat reset beyond a prospectively frozen Monte Carlo tolerance when physical state and current warning are matched.
iid_regime_null.scope: the IID null is defined ONLY at d_min=1. With d_min>1 the process cannot be IID by construction, so running the null there would be a falsifier that cannot fail.

latent_regime.demand_kernel: Conditional on Z_t=i, product i receives share s and every j!=i receives share (1-s)/(N-1); aggregate order times and quantities are unchanged by product labels.
latent_regime.initialization_timing: Draw Z_0 from the uniform prior before the first warning; there is no unobserved pre-t0 transition.

minimum_dwell.d_min_1_is_the_v1_control: d_min=1 recovers v1 exactly: geometric dwell, first-order Markov, exact posterior sufficient. It is the negative control for the whole amendment and is primary, not optional.
minimum_dwell.mean_dwell_is_confounded_and_must_be_con: raising d_min raises the mean dwell, so a d_min effect could be a persistence effect. The executable amendment MUST include cells that match mean dwell between d_min=1 and d_min=4 by lowering rho, or the comparison measures persistence and not misspecification.
minimum_dwell.parameter: d_min, periods a regime must last before it may switch

transition_kernel.dwell_not_served: P(Z_{t+1}=i | Z_t=i, D_t < d_min) = 1; the regime cannot switch
transition_kernel.dwell_served_different: P(Z_{t+1}=j | Z_t=i, D_t >= d_min) = (1-rho)/(N-1) for j!=i

minimum_dwell.why_it_matters: time-since-switch is part of the true state. A first-order two-state filter -- the controller a practitioner writes from the stated dynamics -- cannot represent it and is MISSPECIFIED. That gap, and only that gap, is where a learner can pay.

latent_regime.state_space: (Z_t, D_t) with Z_t in {1,...,N} the dominant product and D_t the periods elapsed since the last switch, truncated at the minimum dwell

transition_kernel.at_d_min_1_this_is_exactly_v1: with d_min=1 the lock never binds and the kernel is v1's, unchanged
transition_kernel.different_state: P(Z_{t+1}=j | Z_t=i, D_t >= d_min)=(1-rho)/(N-1) for j!=i
transition_kernel.dwell_lock: P(Z_{t+1}=i | Z_t=i, D_t < d_min)=1; the regime cannot switch before the dwell is served

required_checks: classical comparator identity and outcome parity

null_cells: fungible products with identical costs, yields and lead times, zero setup and full substitution: exact H_PI=H_obs=0 on the aggregate physical endpoint
IID regime: retained history must not beat reset beyond a prospectively frozen Monte Carlo tolerance
symmetric warning at q=1/N: warning-aware must not beat warning-blind beyond that tolerance

d_min=1 control: with the exact posterior sufficient, the learner must NOT beat the exact belief planner beyond the frozen Monte Carlo tolerance. A learner that wins HERE is evidence of leakage or of an undertrained comparator, never of a premium.

primary_factorial.rule: The executable amendment must state whether every Cartesian-product cell is primary and how multiplicity is controlled before opening a tape.

demand_and_information.primary_markov_scope: For the amortization branch, planner and learner receive the same decision-sufficient physical ledger, public phase and explicit posterior. If an age-resolved backlog or another decision-relevant ledger field is hidden or compressed, that is a separately declared POMDP arm.
demand_and_information.retained_state: Posterior over the dominant-product regime carried across weeks and, only in the H4 branch, across disruption cycles.

warning_kernel.independence_null: At q=1/N every row is uniform, so W_t is independent of Z_t. Accuracy alone is not accepted as proof of independence.

estimands.Delta_N_amortization: Natural online p95 latency and lifecycle break-even reduction conditional on noninferiority to the high-budget teacher
estimands.Delta_N_generalization: Frozen neural minus the prospectively designated frozen or reoptimized structured reference on each explicitly frozen OOD family; the comparator treatment must be stated before training
estimands.Delta_N_quality: V(neural controller) - V(high-budget best structured controller), paired on untouched tapes
estimands.H_PI: V(privileged state planner) - V(best open-loop), including open-loop optimization uncertainty
estimands.H_obs: V(best nonanticipative structured controller) - V(best open-loop), including family selection and optimization uncertainty
estimands.H_ret: V(retained belief controller) - V(reset controller) with byte-identical physical/RNG state
estimands.value_convention: Every V uses the [0,1] primary physical endpoint and higher is better.

allowed_now: runner construction and deterministic synthetic unit tests without opening stochastic tapes
forbidden_now: claiming N=2 executable parity from cardinality
opening development, evaluation or confirmation seeds
reporting a scientific gate as passed
execution_policy.next_authorization: Complete the seed-custody inventory, obtain PI authorization, version-freeze the executable N=2 parity kernel, exact metric implementations, cell/multiplicity family, SESOI/power, compute/SLA protocol, seed namespace and dependency hashes before opening any stochastic development tape.
execution_policy.versioning_rule: This candidate design may change only before seed opening; every material change requires a new version and hashes. v2 is such a change and no seed existed when it was made.

learner_ladder.fixed_n_baseline: Parameter- and training-budget-matched MLP fit separately at each N.
learner_ladder.gnn_gate: A GNN is prohibited until the action-relevant input contains a real variable graph/BOM topology rather than a relabeled set.
learner_ladder.imitation_claim_boundary: Behavioral cloning and DAgger cannot establish quality superiority over their teacher; they can establish fidelity, generalization and amortization.
learner_ladder.kan_role: Architecture sidecar only, never a promotion path without a separate prospective contract.
learner_ladder.offline_rl_role: Not primary while a simulator and online teacher queries are available; narrow logged support cannot substitute for the structured ladder.
learner_ladder.recurrent_candidate: Small GRU; LSTM only as a sensitivity analysis.
learner_ladder.recurrent_gate: A GRU is prohibited unless a model-independent conditional-history test shows that causal raw history changes optimal action or predictive Bayes risk beyond the current decision-sufficient snapshot plus explicit posterior, and the effect beats reset, delayed and shuffled controls out of sample. Under the exact known HMM, the posterior is the sufficient-statistic null.
learner_ladder.residual_rl_constraint: Any residual action is decoded through the same exact three-batch constraint and compared with zero-residual, linear, tree and other simple residual baselines.
learner_ladder.stage_1: Distil the frozen high-budget belief-MPC action/value map by behavioral cloning for an amortization claim only.
learner_ladder.stage_2: Correct covariate shift with DAgger on burned development tapes for an amortization claim only.
learner_ladder.stage_3: Only after the quality branch demonstrates same-information observable residual above a frozen SESOI may bounded residual RL be considered.

action_decoder.forbidden: Independent unconstrained product outputs, clipping or renormalization that can change the three-batch entitlement.
action_decoder.implementation_class: three sequential product allocations or an exact constrained integer decoder
action_decoder.output_semantics: integer weak composition over N products

mechanism.action_definition: A weak composition of exactly three batches among N nonfungible products.
mechanism.resource_interpretation: Entitlements and capacities are policy-invariant. Actual utilization is an outcome and must not be forced equal.
resource_invariants: same realized aggregate demand times and quantities for all paired policies within a tape
same total expected demand and same initial aggregate physical endowment at every product scale
same three weekly batch rights and same charged production capacity for every policy
same scheduled transport rights, payload capacity and charged vehicle-hour endowment for every policy
no action creates inventory or deletes backlog

interpretation.cobb_douglas: Report separately with a comparison-set-independent cost reference. Published exponents are a source sensitivity; any O-Scale recalibration is an explicitly new metric.
interpretation.ret_excel: Report the exact workbook-compatible value and flags for values outside [0,1]; never clip silently and never use it as the sole dense reward.
interpretation.selection: Never choose whichever of ReT or Cobb-Douglas favors the learner after results. Disagreement is reported, not adjudicated post hoc.

mandatory_outcomes: mean and worst-product fill with a frozen zero-demand-product convention
lost and unresolved orders overall and by product
backlog age and normalized service-shortfall AUC
online p50/p95 latency, DES calls and peak memory

primary_physical_endpoint.normalization: native epoch widths sum to the fixed campaign horizon
primary_physical_endpoint.service_level_domain: service_level_k is frozen from the causal physical ledger in [0,1] before any tape opens

secondary_freeze_requirements: source-exponent result separated from O-Scale recalibration
multiplicity family for every inferential secondary contrast

planner_roles.exact_semi_markov_disclosure: A filter over the TRUE (Z, D) state. It is not a comparator the learner must beat; it exists so that an advantage over the misspecified first-order filter can never be reported as an advantage over decision-theoretic optimality. Its gap to the learner is reported in every cell where d_min>1.
planner_roles.operational_budget_matched: Best structured controller under the same predeclared deployment SLA. It is a separate comparator and cannot replace the high-budget teacher in the noninferiority test.
planner_roles.optimization_uncertainty: Open-loop and structured-family selection, family reselection and any certified optimization gap must be propagated through inference.
planner_roles.teacher_high_budget: Best frozen same-information planner run to its preregistered convergence/gap rule. It supplies labels and the quality reference; its natural online cost is measured, not artificially capped to the neural budget.

prospective_thresholds.des_calls_role: reported diagnostic; cannot substitute for the absolute SLA and p95 latency gate

purpose: Prospectively test whether a neural policy can amortize a structured belief planner in a scaled version of the best-supported observable-feedback mechanism in the repository, but only after physical liveness, observable value and an operationally binding planning cost are established without a learner.

reopening_policy.program_q: May be extended only as a new fairness-aware or scaled-compute contract; its absent quality premium remains absent.
reopening_policy.program_w: May not be cited or reopened as the original until its commit and artifacts are recovered; a reconstruction must be labeled forensic.
reopening_policy.program_x: This is a new prospective mechanism/amortization question, not a post-hoc continuation of a failed seed block.

scientific_scope.attribution_rule: Every N>2 product, product-specific BOM or yield, hidden regime, warning channel and scaled action is a declared researcher extension, not a Garrido parameter.
scientific_scope.current_n2_evidence: The deterministic design preflight establishes only four weekly actions and 4^8 calendar cardinality at N=2. It does not establish transition, observation, metric, comparator or outcome parity with Program O/Q.
scientific_scope.forbidden_interpretation: A positive result is not evidence that the published MFSC itself requires neural control. Calendar cardinality is not evidence that belief-MPC is operationally expensive.
scientific_scope.researcher_extension: N nonfungible products sharing a fixed batch bottleneck under a persistent, partially observed demand-mix regime.
scientific_scope.source_locked_anchor: Garrido MFSC aggregate totals and resource ledgers; Program O N=2 is an intended executable anchor that remains pending G0 parity.

shared_prelearner_gates_in_order: G0: executable N=2 event, observation, metric, complete-frontier and classical-outcome parity with Program O/Q in the warning-disabled anchor
G1: exact mass, product-label and policy-invariant entitlement/capacity conservation; endogenous utilization reported separately
G2: every action is live in primary nonfungible cells and the scoped fungible/IID/warning nulls behave as preregistered
G3: material privileged information value H_PI under a prospectively frozen SESOI
G4: material observable feedback value H_obs after propagating comparator and optimization uncertainty

G4b: at d_min>1, the first-order belief planner must measurably underperform the exact semi-Markov filter. If it does not, the misspecification this amendment relies on is not material and the quality branch closes before any learner runs.
G5: the complete structured ladder and replacement tests match information, resources, cadence and horizon
